title: Understanding the Model
text: Sam's model is a linear regression model with two features: $$dist_{from,bell}$$ and $$section_{no}$$. The model is represented as: $$y_{hat}=\theta_0+\theta_1 x_1+\theta_2 x_2$$.

title: Adding Features
text: One-hot encoding the weather variable adds three new features to the model. This means the model now has five features in total.

title: Effect on Training Loss
text: Adding more features to a model can increase its complexity, but it does not necessarily increase the training loss. In fact, it can decrease the training loss or keep it the same.

title: Evaluating the Statement
text: With the same training set, adding more features to Sam's model will not result in higher training loss. Is this statement true or false?
